name: Surena Caledon
summary: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, Gakin seeks his former pupil and a bloodstone choker. He sends an aspiring warlock after Surena Caledon, who betrayed him to join the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Bitter Master
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter, Gakin the Darkbinder teaches novices the forbidden arts of fel summoning. He once took a young woman named Surena Caledon as his pupil. He admired her natural magical talent and her beauty. Surena left her studies and Gakin's favor, then fled Stormwind with her lover, Erlan Drudgemoor, to join the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: The Stolen Bloodstone
sections.body: Gakin has no concern for Surena's survival, but he wants the bloodstone choker he gave her during her apprenticeship. He sends his newest apprentice southeast to Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest, a farmstead overrun by Defias bandits. The apprentice is to take the jewel from Surena by any means necessary. The bloodstone will provide the magical catalyst for the next trial: summoning and binding a Voidwalker.

faq.answer: Surena Caledon was Gakin the Darkbinder's apprentice in Stormwind. She had natural talent and earned his favor and gifts before abandoning her studies to flee with Erlan Drudgemoor, a Defias bandit.

faq.q: Why does Gakin want her choker back?
faq.answer: Gakin gave Surena the choker during her apprenticeship, and it holds a valuable bloodstone. He resents her betrayal and needs the stone as a ritual reagent to help his new apprentice bind a Voidwalker.

faq.q: Where can Surena Caledon be found?
faq.answer: Surena can be found with her Defias companions at Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, an abandoned farmstead in southeastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens after recovering the choker?
faq.answer: Returning the bloodstone choker to Gakin completes the trial. The next step is to enter the summoning circle in the crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb and bind a Voidwalker from the Twisting Nether.
Erlan Drudgemoor is a rogue with the Defias Brotherhood. He seduced Surena Caledon and persuaded her to leave her warlock training and flee Stormwind to live among the bandits.

faq.q: Does Gakin show any remorse over Surena's fate?
faq.answer: Gakin shows no remorse over Surena's fate. He says her life means nothing to him, and that wasting her magical talent is a shame, but her betrayal makes her elimination necessary.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face a proving ground in the hunt for Surena Caledon. Gakin teaches that betrayal carries a lethal cost and sentiment has no place in the dark arts.
As a human, you see how the Defias Brotherhood continues to tempt disgruntled citizens of the kingdom of Stormwind.
